description: Angular component for a dialog to create or edit complex filter predicates in the Thingsboard UI, including form handling, validation, and dialog control.

classes.name: ComplexFilterPredicateDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for managing a dialog to create or edit complex filter predicates, handling form validation, user interactions, and dialog control.
